items.finding: The pressure target is a simulation and the field check conditions on saved plastic strain and imported geometry. It does not independently reproduce the full plastic/contact history, a three-dimensional stability loss or a measured pressure failure.
items.evidence_needed: A declared constitutive/history/import deck and independent continuation/stability check, followed by a relevant pressure-shell experiment.

items.finding: Foam hydrostatic/flow calibration and the steel-axis interpretation are unresolved. At the refined peak, 1543 core points exceed the retained hardening knots; minimum J≈0.398. Agreement at one pressure does not establish those properties.
items.evidence_needed: Matched foam multiaxial, unloading and densification data; confirmed steel curve units and compressive response.

items.finding: CR III catalog direction/thickness/strength anchors do not identify its installed finite-strain tensor, postpeak crushing, unloading, shear failure or mixed loading.
items.evidence_needed: Matched directional core and bonded assembly tests at the proposed thickness, ribbon layout and temperature.

items.finding: SR-200's scalar modulus and tensile minimums do not establish a processed, minimum-gauge biaxial compressive allowable.
items.evidence_needed: Purchased/forming/cure lot data and thin-sheet compression/fracture qualification for the actual gauges.

items.finding: Light 2U identity is established, but exact Be/CR III preparation, cure, residual stress and seam behavior are not.
items.evidence_needed: Exact-process bond and scarf strength/fracture/aging measurements and a released residual-state measurement.

items.finding: The amplitudes use a calibrated Gaussian family at reference pressure 95.4608379 kPa and a tensile proxy. Holding C across changed thickness/shear ratios and carrying a scalar cure debit do not model a complete thermal/weather/seam field.
items.evidence_needed: Measured defect spectra and residual fields, a specified combined load case, and independent prediction of a manufactured curved article before release as shop acceptance.

items.finding: Supported reflector RMS, masked maps, optical segment figure and core-to-face fit do not bound a free pressure shell's local inward defect. ALMA captions mask faulty areas for both prototypes.
items.evidence_needed: Full signed contour data with local amplitude/span, support condition and acceptance masks for a comparable manufactured shell.

items.finding: The R10 thin-sheet class does not establish the inherited 24×72 inch blank layout; forming yield, usable gauge, core fit and purchased Be capacity remain unknown.
items.evidence_needed: Usable blank/gauge quotes, actual nesting and process-yield measurements; reprice seams and flight mass if they change.

items.finding: The cost ranges reproduce only the stated planning assumptions. They are not quotes, measured confidence intervals or complete qualified-flight program totals.
items.evidence_needed: Supplier quotations, measured labor/yield, required article count and full-scale qualification/facility/program scope.

items.finding: ASSUMPTIONS.json names R10 hall and handling rates without explicit radius exponents. Delivered cost lines imply R^2.5 and R^2. The review retains these lines as supplied allowances, not independently sourced predictions.
items.evidence_needed: Document those assumed scaling laws and obtain facility/handling scope and prices.

items.finding: The retained 0.020 kg/m² hardware/filler allowance and passive shape retention after support removal are not demonstrated. Additional structure, repair or growth-driven local loads would need a new bill.
items.evidence_needed: A released joined/closed process article demonstrating retained contour, mass and thermal/pressure response.

scope: Unresolved source/physical questions, not demonstrated arithmetic mismatches.
